name: ambilight-takes-the-brand-from-the-favicon
description:
Round 2: a page whose edges carry no colour glows the colour of its favicon. The fixture is a flat #101010 body with a solid #C02020 icon - the YouTube shape, where the page is grey and the red lives in the mark. Every edge reads #101010, so without the brand blend the glow is a dark grey nobody would call red.

The expected hex is exact: kBrandWeight 0.6 at zero saturation mixes #101010 six tenths of the way to #C02020, which is #7A1A1A, and at glassOpacity 0.2 the core's alpha division clamps to the page's own colour so nothing moves it again. The unit test AGreyEdgeTakesMostOfTheBrand pins the same number.

actions.note: gate: the page committed. A settle alone missed it on a slow start.
the page commits, the favicon resolves, the sampler reads

assertions.label: the-grey-edge-took-the-brand
assertions.desc: THE MEASUREMENT: a #101010 edge resolved to #7A1A1A, which is six tenths of the way to the icon's red. A reader that ignored the favicon logs L=#101010 here.
